# Layout catalog (generated by layout_check --catalog; do not edit)

## Tags

| tag | interactive | what | example |
|---|---|---|---|
| `<window>` | no | top-level window; label= is the title, vars= lists ui files whose keys ${...} read | `<window label="my window" class="database-window managed" vars="state/ui.txt">` |
| `<page>` | no | a page of a window; name= picks it | `<page name="main">` |
| `<panel>` | no | container; pairs with a sidebar | `<panel id="p1">` |
| `<sidebar>` | no | left rail / list container | `<sidebar id="rail">` |
| `<scrolllist>` | no | vertically scrolling list of items | `<scrolllist id="list">` |
| `<tabbar>` | no | horizontal row of tabs | `<tabbar id="toolbar">` |
| `<tab>` | yes (nav number) | clickable toolbar entry; onclick= runs a command | `<tab id="t1" label="File" onclick="sh '${HOUSE}/x.sh'"/>` |
| `<row>` | no | horizontal group; class canvas-overlay-* places it over the canvas | `<row id="r1" class="canvas-overlay-right">` |
| `<item>` | yes (nav number) | clickable row; action= runs a command; gets a nav number | `<item id="i1" label="Open" action="sh '${HOUSE}/x.sh' open"/>` |
| `<button>` | yes (nav number) | clickable button (same as item for actions) | `<button id="b1" label="OK" action="sh '${HOUSE}/x.sh'"/>` |
| `<text>` | no | static text; label= is the text | `<text label="Hello"/>` |
| `<text_area>` | yes (nav number) | multi-line editable field | `<text_area id="notes" target_id="notes" rows="6"/>` |
| `<cli_io>` | yes (nav number) | one-line typed field; target_id= is the state key; action= runs on Enter | `<cli_io id="s1" target_id="search" label="search: " action="sh x.sh"/>` |
| `<canvas>` | no | the 2D/3D blit region | `<canvas id="view"/>` |
| `<grid>` | no | tile / swatch grid | `<grid id="g1">` |
| `<bar>` | no | progress/status bar | `<bar id="hp" value="${hp}" max="100"/>` |
| `<title>` | no | window title strip | `<title label="My window"/>` |
| `<footer>` | no | bottom strip | `<footer id="status">` |
| `<module>` | no | starts a manager process whose ui.txt feeds ${...} (self-closed with src=), or a plain container in old .chtpm | `<module src="@.apps/x/ops/+x/x_manager.+x" args="x"/>` |
| `<repeat>` | no | repeats its children count= times, binding ${key} from bind= | `<repeat count="${n_rows}" bind="r_">` |
| `<overlay>` | no | splices another layout fragment in | `<overlay src="@.apps/x/menu.xhtpm"/>` |
| `<br>` | no | line break | `<br/>` |
| `<interact>` | no | interaction hook (relay) | `<interact relay="..."/>` |

## Attributes

| attribute | meaning |
|---|---|
| `id` | unique name in the window |
| `name` | page name / alias of id |
| `class` | CSS classes (space separated) |
| `label` | visible text; REQUIRED on item/tab/button |
| `action` | shell command run on activate/Enter |
| `onclick` | same as action (tabs) |
| `onClick` | same as action (tabs) |
| `show` | ${key} - hidden when empty/0 |
| `src` | file for module/overlay |
| `args` | arguments for a module |
| `target_id` | cli_io state key (saved in cli_io_state.txt) |
| `count` | repeat count, usually ${n_x} |
| `bind` | repeat key prefix |
| `href` | link target |
| `time_reactive` | re-render on the clock |
| `vars` | ui files whose keys ${...} read |
| `sprite` | sprite image for an item |
| `rows` | text_area rows |
| `backspace_action` | command run on Backspace in an empty cli_io |
| `content` | seeds a cli_io input |
| `confirm` | ask before running action |
| `drop_action` | XDND drop command |
| `drop_highlight` | drop colour |
| `relay` | nav/relay key list |
| `bg` | background colour |
| `visibility` | hidden|visible |
| `inner` | inner layout hint |
| `input_mode` | cli_io mode |
| `value` | bar value / initial value |
| `max` | bar max |
| `width` | rare, prefer CSS |
| `height` | rare, prefer CSS |

## Rules the checker enforces

- ids unique in the window, one word
- item/tab/button/cli_io need a label (cli_io: a short prefix); item/tab/button need action=/onclick=/href=/relay=
- cli_io/text_area need id and a unique target_id (a state key in cli_io_state.txt); a field must open empty (the manager must not trust stale state)
- repeat needs count= and bind=; ${key} must be published by a manager (check with --ui state/ui.txt)
- every tag closed or self-closed; attribute values quoted
